DEAR SIRS:  DURALNY Lights OF

I AM WRITING IN REGARDS TO THE FACT THAT I WAS NEVER SENT A ORDER FORM FOR THE "NEW YORK ZIPPO". THE OTHER DAY I RECEIVED A ORDER FORM FOR THE "VEGAS STRIP ZIPPO". I HAVE ALREADY PURCHASED THE NEW ORLEANS AND SAN FRANCISCO LIGHTERS. TELL ME, WHAT GOOD ARE THOSE WITHOUT THE OTHERS? I HAVE WRITTEN A LOT OF THINGS FROM YOU PEOPLE, NOT TO EVEN MENTION THE FACT THAT I SPEND APPROX. 2290.00 A YEAR ON YOUR CIGARETTES. I HAVE ALWAYS BEEN SATISFIED IN MY DEALINGS WITH YOUR COMPANY AND ITS PRODUCTS UNTIL THIS ZIPPO DEAL. THIS IS THE 3RD TIME I HAVE HAD TO WRITE ABOUT THESE LIGHTERS. TO BEGIN WITH—THE FIRST ZIPPO ARRIVED WITH A DENTED TIN DISPLAY BOX. I HAD TO WRITE ABOUT THAT. YOU WERE VERY PROMPT AND GENEROUS IN SENDING ME ANOTHER BOX, FOR WHICH, I SAY THANK YOU. I THEN SENT IN A "ORDER" FOR THE FRENCH QUARTER ZIPPO, WHICH, BY THE WAY, CAME WITH THE SAN FRANCISCO ZIPPO. WELL I WAITED, SAY—ZZ-3 MCS, BUT IT NEVER CAME. I HAD TO WRITE ABOUT NOT GETTING IT.
